name: Stoneware Pour-Over Set
description: A hand-thrown stoneware pour-over brewer and matching carafe with a matte reactive glaze. The wide spiral ribs slow the water flow for a fuller extraction, and each piece comes out of the kiln with its own character.

name: Walnut Desk Organizer
description: A solid walnut caddy with five compartments sized for pens, cards, cables and a phone. Finished with natural oil so the grain deepens with age.

details.Materials: Solid American walnut, natural oil finish
details.Care: Wipe with a dry cloth, re-oil yearly

name: Linen Throw — Sage
description: A stonewashed 100% European linen throw in a muted sage. Pre-washed for softness, with a hand-knotted fringe on both ends.

name: Cast Iron Trivet Duo
description: Two nesting cast-iron trivets with silicone feet — one round for pots, one long for baking trays. Heat-safe to 300 °C.

details.Dimensions: Round Ø18 cm · Long 28 cm × 10 cm

name: Cork Globe Lamp
description: A table lamp turned from a single block of Portuguese cork with a frosted glass globe. Warm 2700 K dimmable bulb included.

details.Materials: Solid cork, frosted glass, brass fittings

name: Recycled Glass Carafe
description: A 1-litre carafe mouth-blown from 100% recycled glass, with a tumbler that doubles as its lid. Tiny air bubbles are part of the story.

name: Wool Felt Mouse Pad
description: A 3 mm merino wool felt pad with a vegetable-tanned leather corner tab. Naturally anti-static and easy on the wrist.

name: Ceramic Planter — Ochre
description: A speckled ochre planter with a drainage hole and matching saucer. The unglazed base lets roots breathe.

name: Brass Page Holder
description: A weighted solid-brass thumb ring that holds a book open one-handed. Develops a warm patina with use.

details.Dimensions: Ø5.5 cm, fits thumbs up to 25 mm
details.Care: Polish with brass cloth or let it patina

name: Alpaca Cushion Cover
description: A baby-alpaca cushion cover in a soft rose-taupe herringbone, with a hidden zip and duck-feather insert available separately.
